'''Rancher Clothing''' is an [[Outfits|outfit]] found in ''[[Red Dead Redemption]] ''and'' [[Undead Nightmare]]''. It is also featured in ''[[Red Dead Redemption 2]]''.

==Description==
At the end of the [[Missions in Redemption|mission]] "[[And The Truth Will Set You Free]]", [[John Marston|Marston's]] default clothing becomes the Rancher Clothing. For several major gameplay missions, Marston cannot change his outfit in any [[Safehouses|safehouse]] or [[Camps|camp]]. The player will not be able to change outfits again until completing the mission "[[The Last Enemy That Shall Be Destroyed]]".

==Acquisition==
===''Red Dead Redemption''===
It can be obtained after completing the [[Missions in Redemption|mission]] "[[The Outlaw's Return]]". It can be found on the Marston Ranch at [[Beecher's Hope]] in [[Great Plains]], [[West Elizabeth]].

===''Undead Nightmare''===
In ''Undead Nightmare'', it is seen at the beginning of "[[Love in the Time of Plague]]", and can be obtained at the start of the game.

=== ''Red Dead Redemption 2''===
The Rancher outfit is unlocked completing the [[Missions in Redemption 2|mission]] "[[Motherhood]]".

==Trivia==
*The [[Bandolier]], satchel, and knife are not shown while wearing this outfit.
*Sometimes, after using the cheat to unlock the Rancher Clothing and then putting it on, the game may not let the player change outfits again unless reloading or using the Jack Attack [[Cheats in Redemption|cheat]].
*Sometimes, when wearing the outfit, Marston may be called "Preacher". This is a direct reference to Clint Eastwood's character in the western ''Pale Rider''.
*It is unknown how Jack obtained the outfit, seeing his father was shot to death and presumably buried in it. Jack himself wears a similar outfit in 1911, and several NPC's are seen in similar clothing, meaning Jack may have patched up the outfit after his father's death, or more likely purchased it in the years following his father's death. 
**Although John's [[Undead Cowboy Outfit]] confirms that he was buried in the [[Elegant Suit]] (with the gloves and bandana replacing the coat and hat), this only applies in the ''[[Undead Nightmare]]'' canon.
*On the trailer, Marston is seen wearing this outfit in the mission "[[At Home With Dutch]]". This is impossible in the final Game.
*There is an occasional glitch when choosing this outfit as [[Jack Marston]]. Upon selection of the Rancher Clothing, Jack will change into his regular [[Cowboy Outfit]], or stay in the outfit the player is currently wearing. This can be fixed by reloading a save.
*A similar outfit is seen in the epilogue for ''[[Red Dead Redemption 2]]'', simply dubbed "The Rancher." It is nearly identical to this one; it has different range gloves and a slightly different vest.
**It is also shown in the epilogue, during "[[Motherhood]]", that the shirt for this outfit was a gift to John from [[Abigail Marston|Abigail]].
**A version similar to the ''RDR1'' version (unbuttoned vest and unbuttoned shirt) is seen in the credits.
**Following the completion of "[[Home of the Gentry?]]", John will automatically be wearing this outfit but without the vest and gloves.
